text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-kun!
Did you watch? My run!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-chan!
Did you watch? My run!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that just shows how much
fun my race with Grass-chan was♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I was just as happy...
to see how much my junior has grown.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Just thinking that we might get to run together again in the future makes my heart flutter non-stop~!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now, I wonder which race I should show everyone my heels in next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There are several candidates, but considering the conditions that suit her running style and where the strong contenders will gather—
choice_data_list: Let's make the Tenno Sho (Autumn) our goal!
Let's make the Tenno Sho (Autumn) our goal!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds great! The distance is spot-on,
and Tokyo feels like home to me, so I love it!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna enjoy the Tenno Sho Autumn to the absolute fullest~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Grass-chan!
That was a nice race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, it really was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...However, even giving it my all,
I just couldn't catch up to her back..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm full of regrets, constantly thinking 'if only I had done this, or done that.'

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, judging by those eyes,
it looks like your fighting spirit has only grown bigger, far from being extinguished.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll train even harder
and show you I can win someday for sure.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, pushing each other to greater heights
is truly wonderful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm glad it looked like a fun race for Grass-chan too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Since we had this much fun, I'm sure the joy reached everyone watching, too."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There might just be someone itching
to run with you right this very moment~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm looking forward to the day I get to run with a girl like that♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having triumphed in a magnificent race against a junior rival,
her next destination is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That was such an amazing race~!
I got so hyped up that my voice went hoarse!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to try running
in a race like this together too~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I want to run a race like this too...!
